title: Kerberoasting SPN Request with RC4 Encryption - Volumetric Correlation
description:
Correlation rule layered on top of kerberoasting_rc4_base.yml: fires when
the same TargetUserName is seen in 10 or more qualifying RC4 TGS-request
events within a 5 minute window. This is the STATEFUL half of the
comparison. Sigma correlation rules are a SEPARATE rule type (see
https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma-specification/blob/main/specification/sigma-correlation-rules-specification.md)
layered on a base detection rule by `rule` reference, not a capability of
a plain detection rule.
sigma: SELECT TargetUserName, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (EventID=4769 AND TicketEncryptionType='0x17' AND (TicketOptions='0x40810000' OR TicketOptions='0x40800000' OR TicketOptions='0x40810010')) AND (NOT ServiceName LIKE '%$' ESCAPE '\')) AS subquery GROUP BY TargetUserName HAVING event_count >= 10
